story: As a payments switch, I want to obtain a short-lived access token with my client credentials, so that I can call HSM services without storing long-lived secrets in requests
acceptance: Given valid client credentials When I request a token Then I receive a bearer token that expires in 15 minutes
Given no token or an expired, tampered or unsigned token When I call any protected endpoint Then the request is refused with 401

story: As a security officer, I want each client limited to the operations of its role, so that a compromised client cannot do more than its job
acceptance: Given the card-issuing client When it requests a PIN translation Then it is refused with 403 insufficient_scope
Given the security-officer client When it reads the audit log Then the entries are returned

story: As a key owner, I want my keys to be invisible and unusable to other clients, so that another channel cannot use my keys
acceptance: Given a key owned by another client When I read or use it Then I receive 404 as if it did not exist

story: As a CISO, I want keys generated inside the HSM, bound to one purpose and never exposed in clear, so that we meet PCI PIN key-management rules
acceptance: Given a newly generated key When the response is returned Then it contains a key check value and a wrapped key block but no clear key
Given a MAC key When it is used to translate a PIN Then the request is refused with key_usage_violation

story: As a card operations analyst, I want to translate PIN blocks between zone keys in ISO-0 and ISO-4 format, so that PINs move securely between networks
acceptance: Given two PIN keys and a valid ISO-4 PIN block When I translate it Then I receive a same-length block under the destination key
Given a PIN block of the wrong length When I translate it Then the request is refused with 422 and the block is not echoed

story: As a payments switch, I want to generate and verify MACs on ISO 8583 messages, so that tampered messages are detected
acceptance: Given a message and its MAC When one byte of the message changes Then verification returns false

story: As a security tester, I want hostile input rejected without stack traces or reflected values, so that attackers learn nothing from errors
acceptance: Given an injection payload in a key id or label When I send it Then I receive a 4xx error that does not contain the payload or internal detail

story: As an internal auditor, I want every key and cryptographic operation logged with who, what and the outcome, so that I can investigate incidents
acceptance: Given a PIN translation When I read the audit log Then an entry shows client, action, key id and outcome
Given any operation When I search the audit log Then no PIN block, message data or key appears

story: As a platform owner, I want per-client rate limits and request size limits, so that one client cannot exhaust the HSM
acceptance: Given a client over its per-minute limit When it calls a cryptographic endpoint Then it receives 429
Given a request body larger than 16 KB When it is sent Then it is refused with 413

story: As a security officer, I want a client locked after ten failed authentications, so that credentials cannot be brute-forced
acceptance: Given ten failed authentications When the correct secret is then sent Then the client is locked for 15 minutes

story: As a security officer, I want hardened HTTP headers on every response, so that clients never downgrade to insecure transport
acceptance: Given any response When I inspect its headers Then HSTS, nosniff, no-store and CSP are present and no server banner is shown
